podcast.body: Released in the fall of 1969 with the Trinidad Singers, this single served as a precursor to the *Jesus Christ Superstar* album and stage production. It entered the Billboard Hot 100 in January 1970, reaching approximately number 74, and appeared on and off the charts for several months. "Superstar by Murray Head and the Trinidad Singers, which was released in the fall of 1969."
